kept.title: Active resurfacing on Mutual St near the location
kept.detail: Road resurfacing is listed as Active on three blocks of Mutual St, between 147 m and 166 m from the point, with a timeline of Q2 2025 - Q2 2026. The City says the work includes repairs to damaged sidewalks and curbs and may close lanes or the whole road. The data does not show whether sidewalks on the walking route to the stops will be closed or rerouted.

cites.quote: MUTUAL ST; From: GERRARD ST E; To: MC GILL ST | status: Active | timeline: Q2 2025 - Q2 2026 | 147 m from the point
including repairs of any damaged sidewalks and curbs. Work may include the closure of individual lanes or the entire road.

kept.title: Sidewalk clearing starts at 2 cm of snow and can take about 12 hours
kept.detail: The City's report says sidewalk clearing begins once snow reaches 2 cm. It also says crews usually finish a full clearing cycle in about 12 hours. Sidewalks may not be cleared yet in the hours after snowfall.

cites.quote: the City begins sidewalk clearing once snow accumulation reaches 2 cm.
City crews typically complete a full sidewalk clearing cycle within approximately 12 hours once accumulation reaches 2 cm.

kept.title: Public laneways are salted only, not plowed
kept.detail: The report says public laneways are only salted, within 24 hours after snowfall ends, and are not plowed. The data does not show whether any laneway is part of a walking route from this address.

cites.quote: The Council-approved winter maintenance service level for public laneways is salting only, within 24 hours after the end of snowfall, to manage icy conditions; snow plowing is not provided.
